Name: Old School Runescape Dragon Scimitar
Author: ElisandraSDV
Description: This is my first coding/modding attempt. This weapon is a replica of the same-named item in Old School Runescape. Use it for nostalgia or just enjoy the super cool look in your character's hands. The choice is yours, and the possibilities are endless (not really, there's only one, but you get the gist).

Downloads.Description: A file that includes the dragon scimitar image and the coding to add it to the game.

Manifest.Name: Old School Runescape Dragon Scimitar
Manifest.Description: A nod to Old School Runescape brings the famed Dragon Scimitar. This time you don't have to battle monkeys to get it.
